without_these_rules: the mesh deforms as plain linear blend skinning (twist bones follow their parents, corrective weights stay 0)

twist_bones.lowerarm_twist_01_<s>: local rotation about its own Y = 0.5 x twist of hand_<s> relative to lowerarm_<s> about lowerarm Y (swing-twist decomposition)
twist_bones.upperarm_twist_01_<s>: local rotation about its own Y = -0.5 x twist of upperarm_<s>'s own local rotation about its Y

angles.elbow: angle in degrees between the posed directions (head->tail) of upperarm_<s> and lowerarm_<s> (rest pose = spec rest)
angles.knee: angle in degrees between the posed directions of thigh_<s> and calf_<s>
angles.hip: hip flexion: signed angle of thigh_<s>'s direction relative to its rest direction, about the pelvis' lateral axis (rest world +X carried by the pelvis), projected on the plane normal to it; thigh forward = positive

correctives.weights: piecewise-linear in-betweens over [rest] + samples: between two neighbouring samples the two shapes cross-fade linearly (weights sum 1); rest..first sample: first shape 0->1; beyond the last sample: last shape = 1; at or below rest: all 0
correctives.note: each shape is a rest-space offset solved so that plain LBS + the shape reproduces Blender's dual-quaternion (Preserve Volume) pose at its angle
